title: Project-slice freshness assertion for CURRENT routers

source_provenance.observation: Router was CURRENT but embedded BLOODBOUND slice still said E01-E07/E08-next after controlling D10 state had Founder-locked E01-E24.
B03 Cycle32 identified and repaired the stale slice while preserving historical research evidence.

The B03 branch first reused SI-0008, then attempted SI-0014 from a stale registry-family view. Fresh main proved SI-0014 already belongs to Session Resilience. Open-PR reservation search found SI-0015 unallocated; candidate migrated to SI-0015 before merge.

problem_or_opportunity: A globally CURRENT router can contain a stale embedded project frontier. Cold-start agents may follow the stale local instruction even when a higher project state is correct.
proposed_mechanism: For every router section that asserts a current project frontier/next action, resolve the controlling project-state pointer and compare status/frontier. Fail or warn on contradiction. Explicit HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED/REFERENCE slices are exempt and remain usable as evidence.

development_contract.positive_fixture: BLOODBOUND stale E07/E08 slice vs Founder-locked E01-E24 controlling state
development_contract.negative_fixture: explicitly HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED BLOODBOUND research example must not be flagged as a current contradiction
must_not: treat modification date alone as authority

pilot_evidence: 2026-08-21 manual freshness comparison correctly detected and repaired the BLOODBOUND embedded slice
red_team_findings: Naive detector will produce false positives on intentionally historical examples; status-label exemption is mandatory.
A filename/current timestamp does not prove embedded project claims are fresh.
Candidate identity must be checked against the full CURRENT registry family plus open-PR reservations immediately before persistence.
SI-0014 is protected identity for Session Resilience and must not be reused by B03 project-slice freshness.
next_action: Execute N55 positive canary and N56 historical negative fixture; only then consider central registry promotion/engine integration.
notes: Correct identity is SI-0015. SI-0008 and stale-branch SI-0014 allocations are preserved only as collision provenance, not live candidate identities.
